objective: Locate complete visible insulator assemblies in UK overhead-line images and identify their dielectric material with explicit abstention.
deployment_domain: UK overhead distribution and transmission imagery; ground, oblique and UAV views remain separate evaluation strata.

classes.name: glass
classes.definition: The load-bearing dielectric body is glass. Metal caps, pins and fittings inside the assembly do not change this label.

classes.name: porcelain_ceramic
classes.definition: The load-bearing dielectric body is porcelain or another source-described ceramic. Do not infer porcelain from colour alone.

classes.name: polymer_composite
classes.definition: The load-bearing dielectric body is a source-described polymeric or composite insulator.

localisation_unit.target: one physically continuous visible insulator assembly from attachment endpoint to attachment endpoint; for a pin insulator, the complete insulating body and its immediately attached fitting
localisation_unit.include_metal_fittings: inside the localisation extent when they belong to the same continuous assembly, but exclude them from material semantics
forbidden_unit_changes: individual sheds or discs must not be silently converted into whole-string targets
multiple parallel strings must not be merged into one target
unlabelled plausible components must not be invented as reference truth
localisation_unit.incompatible_source_policy: quarantine or retain in a source-specific auxiliary task; never mix incompatible units in the primary detector or metric

architecture.stage_2: tight and context crop material classifier
architecture.existing_yolo26_supervised_role: localisation baseline only because its glass and polymer source categories were collapsed to one insulator class
architecture.existing_siglip2_head_role: crop-classification baseline only; its previous automatic result is not promoted

rejection_requirements: minimum frozen material margin or calibrated acceptance score
reject truncated or severely occluded localisation
reject target-domain outliers under a frozen rule

split_by: asset or capture group when available

required_evaluation_strata: pin versus suspension or strain morphology
source dataset and UK source group

metrics.confidence_policy: keep localisation and material scores separate until a target-labelled calibration set supports a joint score

execution: New model jobs run only on Roihu gputest under project_2012997. Completed experiments are not rerun automatically.
